components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single dominant navigation action on a marketing section.
components.html: Start with Manteen
components.css: .ds-action-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:2.75rem; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; padding:.5rem 1rem; border-radius:.375rem; background:var(--color-fd-primary); color:var(--color-fd-primary-foreground); font:500 .875rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans); text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 100ms; } .ds-action-primary svg { width:1rem; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-action-primary:hover svg, .ds-action-primary:focus-visible svg { transform:translateX(.2rem); } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-fd-ring); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A same-size outline action for the secondary audience.
components.css: .ds-action-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:2.75rem; align-items:center; padding:.5rem 1rem; border:1px solid var(--color-fd-border); border-radius:.375rem; background:transparent; color:var(--color-fd-foreground); font:500 .875rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans); text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 100ms; } .ds-action-secondary:hover { background:var(--color-fd-accent); } .ds-action-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-fd-ring); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Proof Band
components.description: A claim paired with real, inspectable evidence.
components.html:
Own the claim.

Explain the contract in direct product language.

manteen update --dry-run --json
components.css: .ds-proof-band { --ds-accent:oklch(.78 .15 78); position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.92fr) minmax(0,1.08fr); gap:2rem; align-items:center; padding:2rem; border-block:1px solid var(--color-fd-border); background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--color-fd-card) 72%,transparent); color:var(--color-fd-foreground); } .ds-proof-band::before { position:absolute; top:-1px; left:0; width:100%; height:1px; background:var(--ds-accent); content:""; transform:scaleX(.14); transform-origin:left; transition:transform 520ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-proof-band:hover::before, .ds-proof-band:focus-within::before { transform:scaleX(1); } .ds-proof-band h2 { margin:0; font:600 2rem/1.08 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-proof-band p { color:var(--color-fd-muted-foreground); line-height:1.7; } .ds-proof-band pre { overflow:auto; padding:1rem; border:1px solid var(--color-fd-border); border-radius:.75rem; background:var(--color-fd-background); font-family:var(--font-mono); }

components.name: Source Map
components.description: A compact author-to-consumer path anchored by one amber rail.
components.css: .ds-source-map { --ds-accent:oklch(.78 .15 78); position:relative; border-block:1px solid var(--color-fd-border); color:var(--color-fd-foreground); } .ds-source-map::before { position:absolute; inset-block:0; left:1rem; width:1px; background:var(--ds-accent); content:""; } .ds-source-map > div { display:grid; gap:.2rem; padding:1rem 1rem 1rem 3rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-fd-border); } .ds-source-map > div:last-child { border-bottom:0; } .ds-source-map span { color:var(--color-fd-muted-foreground); font:.75rem var(--font-sans); } .ds-source-map code { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; font:.78rem var(--font-mono); }

components.name: Code Evidence
components.description: An executable artifact with the system's only ambient depth.
components.css: .ds-code-evidence { margin:0; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--color-fd-border); border-radius:.75rem; background:var(--color-fd-card); color:var(--color-fd-foreground); box-shadow:0 1.25rem 3rem -2rem color-mix(in oklab,var(--color-fd-foreground) 30%,transparent); } .ds-code-evidence figcaption { padding:.75rem 1rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-fd-border); color:var(--color-fd-muted-foreground); font:.75rem var(--font-sans); } .ds-code-evidence pre { overflow:auto; margin:0; padding:1rem; font:.875rem/1.5 var(--font-mono); }

narrative.overview:
Manteen inherits the calm, neutral utility of Fumadocs and adds one precise technical signature: real source contracts traced in amber. The visual system should feel authored for developers without turning monospace, terminals, or data into decoration.

Marketing surfaces earn confidence through inspectable examples, strong type, and deliberate spacing. Product truth remains more important than spectacle, but the composition can be bold when the evidence stays real.
keyCharacteristics: Fumadocs neutrals in both light and dark themes
Large, tightly tracked Geist display type with JetBrains Mono reserved for code and paths
Hairline rules, staggered evidence surfaces, and one rare amber trace
Flat structure at rest with restrained depth around executable evidence

rules.name: The One Trace Rule
rules.body: Amber identifies proof relationships and stays a minority color on every screen.

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Components consume Fumadocs semantic roles so light and dark modes keep the same hierarchy rather than merely inverting literal colors.

rules.name: The Source Only Rule
rules.body: Monospace means executable code, registry data, file paths, or measured values; ordinary marketing language remains Geist.

rules.name: The Evidence Earns Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to code or similarly inspectable artifacts, never to empty marketing containers.

dos: Do use real registry fields, paths, and CLI commands as the visual proof.
Do keep consumer source ownership primary while preserving a visible registry-author path.
Do verify the actual copy at desktop, breakpoint-adjacent, and phone widths.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion, and both semantic themes.
donts: Don't fabricate customers, benchmarks, testimonials, or a completed registry catalog.
Don't turn the page into a grid of equal icon-heading-text cards.
Don't use the retired Starlight landing page as visual authority.
Don't use amber as a large background wash or monospace as decorative atmosphere.
